**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Live Meeting: no more lost audio
- **A part of a meeting that can't be transcribed is no longer thrown away.** If you are offline, out of quota, or the service is down, recording continues and that part's audio is kept on your Mac.
- **You hear about it right away.** A popup appears on the first failed part, and when a meeting starts without an internet connection.
- **Retried for you.** When the meeting ends, the kept audio is transcribed again. Anything still missing shows up in the menu bar menu as **Retry Meeting Transcription**. Hold ⌥ to show the kept audio in Finder instead.
- Recovered text lands at its original place in the transcript, and the summary is written once the transcript is complete.

## Dictate Prompt
- **Edit quick actions no longer invent text when nothing is selected.** "Fix grammar", "Rewrite", "Format as a to-do" and "Translate" now ask for a selection instead of writing something new. Typed text still composes as before.
- The offline "Not in your dictation" warning now also shows during a meeting.
- A single typed space no longer blocks the arrow keys and Return on quick actions, and the arrow keys leave input-method composition alone.

## Read Aloud
- Fixed playback that could stall when the text contained blank stretches.

## Chat
- Stopping a reply now keeps the tool calls that had already run.
- Fixed a rare crash in the workspace file cache.

## Settings
- Clearer labels for the Dictate Prompt shortcut and the model section. GPT models are listed without the "OpenAI" prefix.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.40...v8.41
